title: Parallel Execution Directive — Parallel by Default is Ratified Law

source.source_reference: Shawn's direct verbal directive, 2026-10-06, during the NayaPOWER Reveal narration bake. Ratified as law 0013 (PARALLEL-EXECUTION-V1), merged at 3f797551 via PR #1651.

intelligence.essence: If work can be done in parallel, it must be done in parallel. Sequential execution of independent work is waste, and waste is unintelligent.

human_view.meaning: Shawn made parallel execution a standing law: if work can be done at the same time, it is done at the same time.
human_view.why_it_matters: The team's goal is to be the most hyper-efficient, effective execution team in the world.
